info.title: CF Meet Platform Access internal API
info.description: Internal HTTP surface of services/platform-access, the shared identity authority (Part IV Workstream B, ADR 0032): GET /health and /ready (public, no data) and the service-authenticated /internal/v1 API. Every /internal/v1 path — including unknown ones — requires a valid service token (cfmeet.platform.internal-http) and the operation's permission from Platform Access's trust bundle; a customer credential is never accepted in its place. Request bodies are limited to 64 KiB. Messages are defined by cfmeet.platform-access.identity. Consumers: Calling (authenticate, resolve / register principals, read identity and the change feed), Meeting Service (first-party principal ensure, Part V H §104), Messaging (authenticate, resolve, read identity), Numbering (authenticate, resolve, read identity), the operator console (administration). 1.4.0: Developer Platform service-account delegation (Part VI §50) — /internal/v1/delegation/environments/{environmentId}/service-accounts[/{serviceAccountId}[/status]] (create, list, read, suspend / resume; non-production environments only; no credential operation). 1.5.0 (Part VI §54 / §55): delegated credential self-service (issue / list / get / rotate / revoke / suspend / resume), reversible credential suspension (credential_suspended), delegated STANDARD scope grants and withdrawals, production-environment activation for approved requests and delegated live telecom of activated PRODUCTION environments. 1.6.0 (Blueprint Section 7, ADR 0058): governed FIRST_PARTY organization scopes for the Organizations Service only (platform-identity.provision-first-party) — PUT / GET /internal/v1/organization-scopes/{organizationRef}/{capability} (idempotent create-or-return and read-back of the organization's dedicated FIRST_PARTY tenant, first-party application and PRODUCTION-kind environment) and POST .../status (tenant suspension / resumption); never credentials, scope grants or EXTERNAL tenants. 1.7.0 (Blueprint Section 15): GET /internal/v1/admin/audit (operator-only, paginated read of the append-only operator audit trail, PLT-009); POST /internal/v1/delegation/tenants/{tenantId}/display-name (organization rename propagation to EXTERNAL tenants, audited TENANT_RENAMED, ORG-013); GET /internal/v1/delegation/tenant-slugs/{slug} (organization-creation reconciliation, ORG-014); credential views add lastAuthenticatedAt (debounced last successful authentication, null when never seen) and expiringSoon (stops authenticating within 14 days, PLT-008). 1.8.0 (Blueprint Section 14, ACC-010): POST /internal/v1/principals/account-status — the first-party account authority (platform-principal.ensure) mirrors an account's current status onto its NATIVE_CF_USER principal (ACTIVE / SUSPENDED / DEACTIVATED; idempotent; never creates or revives a tombstoned principal). 1.9.0 (ADR 0058 Amendment A2): automatic organization service bindings for the Organizations Service (platform-identity.bind-organization-services): PUT / GET / DELETE /internal/v1/organization-scopes/{organizationRef}/{capability}/service-bindings/{service} and POST …/rotate — the organization's Calling / Messaging service account and credential inside its own FIRST_PARTY triple with a closed scope set; the secret is never returned. 1.10.0 (ADR 0062, CF Meet Platform "Build"; every operation behind a default-off flag, off: 404 NOT_FOUND): the partner Users API for the Developer Console (platform-end-users.delegate, CF-Forwarded-Credential-Id re-verified live, EXTERNAL environments only) — POST / GET /internal/v1/end-users, GET / PATCH / DELETE /internal/v1/end-users/{userId}, POST …/revoke-sessions, user-token minting POST /internal/v1/end-users/{userId}/tokens and POST /internal/v1/end-users/tokens (scope user_tokens.issue), and the console read GET /internal/v1/delegation/environments/{environmentId}/end-users; user-token verification POST /internal/v1/user-tokens/verify and GET /internal/v1/user-tokens/keys (platform-user-token.verify); allowed websites GET /internal/v1/environment-origins (change feed), GET /internal/v1/environments/{environmentId}/origins (platform-environment-origins.read) and GET / PUT /internal/v1/delegation/environments/{environmentId}/allowed-origins (platform-identity.delegate); partner meeting principals POST /internal/v1/principals/ensure-meeting-platform (platform-principal.ensure-meeting-platform). New error codes SCOPE_REQUIRED, LIMIT_EXCEEDED, RATE_LIMITED, USER_TOKEN_INVALID, USER_TOKEN_EXPIRED, USER_TOKEN_REVOKED. 1.11.0 (ADR 0062): console test user tokens POST /internal/v1/delegation/environments/{environmentId}/test-user-tokens (platform-identity.delegate + X-CF-Delegated-Actor; ACTIVE SANDBOX environments of EXTERNAL tenants only; no credential: the token's credentialId / serviceAccountId are the environment's synthetic console-test markers; TTL at most 3600 s; grants bounded by the application's current SANDBOX scope grants; audited USER_TOKEN_TEST_ISSUED); POST /internal/v1/user-tokens/verify accepts them. 1.12.0 (ADR 0064, CF Meet Apps / "Integrate"; every operation behind PLATFORM_ACCESS_OAUTH_ENABLED, off: 404 NOT_FOUND): OAuth client profiles, client secrets and app grant listing for the Developer Console (platform-oauth.manage) — PUT / GET /internal/v1/oauth/clients/{applicationId}, POST …/secret, GET …/grants; authorization for the Meeting Service (platform-oauth.authorize) — POST /internal/v1/oauth/authorization-requests/validate, POST /internal/v1/oauth/authorizations, GET /internal/v1/oauth/grants, DELETE /internal/v1/oauth/grants/{grantId}; the token endpoint backend for the Developer Console (platform-oauth.token) — POST /internal/v1/oauth/token, /revoke, /introspect. POST /internal/v1/credentials/authenticate (and delegated-authority) also accept cfoa_ / cfob_ app tokens: the authority chain is the grant's target FIRST_PARTY triple and installation service account, scopes are mapped from the grant, the principal restriction is exactly the user / bot principal, and the chain adds credentialKind, appId and grantId. The identity change feed gains APP_GRANT. New error codes INVALID_CLIENT, INVALID_REDIRECT_URI, INVALID_SCOPE, PKCE_REQUIRED, APP_NOT_AVAILABLE and RFC 6749 invalid_grant, invalid_client, unsupported_grant_type, invalid_request. 1.12.0 also: client profiles take optional developerName, logoUrl and meetingSurface {url, origins}; grant items carry app {name, developerName, logoUrl, meetingSurface} and the pairwise sub; authentication / credential status of OAuth tokens add restrictedPrincipal {id, kind, reference} and credentialIssuedAt. 1.13.0 (ADR 0068, admin bridge): operator attribution (X-CF-Operator, X-CF-Approver, X-CF-Approval-Ref, X-CF-Intent-Digest) is accepted from cfmeet.admin-bridge (strict hq:<staff>) and, for the legacy named operator only, from the operator console; from any other caller any of them is refused (INTERNAL_PERMISSION_DENIED). The admin bridge's read-only operator views under GET /internal/v1/operator/*: tenants, a tenant's applications, environments, service accounts, scope grants, API keys (public id and last four only), principals (exact-match search, external reference never returned), allowed websites, cross-tenant identity-record search, OAuth apps and their grants, and the audit trail without detail; each requires platform-identity.administer and the bridge's HQ operator.

cfServiceAuth.name: X-CF-Service-Authorization
cfServiceAuth.description: Bearer <service token> (cfmeet.platform.internal-http). Permissions come only from Platform Access's trust bundle.

CfDelegatedActor.name: X-CF-Delegated-Actor
CfDelegatedActor.description: The acting party: `u-<32 lowercase hex>` (a human member the Developer Platform authorized) `s-<32 lowercase hex>` (the service account of a scoped machine credential) or `o-<32 lowercase hex>` (a Developer Platform operator command); recorded as operator `devplat.<actor>` in the append-only audit.

CfForwardedCredentialId.name: CF-Forwarded-Credential-Id
CfForwardedCredentialId.description: ADR 0062: the id of the API credential the API Gateway authenticated (taken by the Developer Console from its signed delegated context). Platform Access re-verifies it LIVE (revocation, expiry, suspension, service account, current scopes); it is the ONLY source of the environment. When the service token also carries a delegated platform context, its credential and scope must match.

BridgeOperator.name: X-CF-Operator
BridgeOperator.description: The HQ staff member the admin bridge reads for (`hq:<staff>`; ADR 0068). Accepted only from cfmeet.admin-bridge.

OrganizationScope.description: The governed FIRST_PARTY scope of one first-party organization (ids, statuses and classification only).

verified.description: FIRST_PARTY tenant with the reserved slug owning the application owning a PRODUCTION environment.

active.description: Tenant, application and environment are all ACTIVE.

OrganizationServiceBinding.description: The Calling / Messaging service account and credential Platform Access provisioned for one first-party organization inside its own FIRST_PARTY triple (ADR 0058 Amendment A2). Ids, statuses and scopes only — never a secret, verifier, public id or masked credential.

authenticates.description: Whether authentication would accept the credential now (credential state, service account and the whole triple ACTIVE, binding not revoked).

EndUser.description: ADR 0062: a partner user (an EXTERNAL_APPLICATION_PRINCIPAL principal of the credential's environment) and its profile.

externalId.description: The partner's opaque id (never a telephone number or SIP address).

EndUserPage.description: A page of visible (not deleted) partner users in creation order.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page.

externalId.description: 1-128 printable ASCII characters without spaces; telephone numbers, tel: / sip: URIs and the reserved tombstoned: prefix are refused.

displayName.description: 1-64 characters, no control characters; null clears it.

imageUrl.description: An https:// URL of at most 512 characters; null clears it.

displayName.description: 1-64 characters, no control characters; null clears it.

imageUrl.description: An https:// URL of at most 512 characters; null clears it.

tokensNotBefore.description: User tokens issued before this instant are revoked (the next whole second after the call).

UserTokenGrants.description: Grants of a CF Meet user token. Every part is optional in requests and always present in responses. Required credential scopes: msg:read messages.read, msg:send messages.send, call:receive calls.write, mtg meetings.write.

token.description: Returned once; never stored or logged by Platform Access.

externalId.description: 1-128 printable ASCII characters without spaces; telephone numbers, tel: / sip: URIs and the reserved tombstoned: prefix are refused.

displayName.description: 1-64 characters, no control characters; null clears it.

imageUrl.description: An https:// URL of at most 512 characters; null clears it.

token.description: Returned once; never stored or logged by Platform Access.

VerifyUserTokenResult.description: A valid user token: its scope, the user and the EFFECTIVE grants (claimed grants intersected with the minting credential's current scopes). Consumers may cache it for at most 30 s, keyed by tokenId.

x.description: Raw public key, base64url without padding.

status.description: RETIRED: tokens it signed are USER_TOKEN_REVOKED.

SetEnvironmentOriginsRequest.description: At most 20 exact origins scheme://host[:port]: lowercase host, no path / query / fragment / user info / wildcard, no default port; https only, except http://localhost[:port] and http://127.0.0.1[:port] (SANDBOX and TEST environments only; a PRODUCTION environment never lists a loopback host). Duplicates are dropped.

EnvironmentOriginFeed.description: The allowed-websites change feed: one item per change (origin list or effective status), carrying the environment's LATEST state.

environmentStatus.description: ACTIVE when the environment, its application and its tenant are ACTIVE.

EnsureMeetingPlatformPrincipalRequest.description: Exactly one of two combinations: BOT_OR_SERVICE with `cfmeet:meeting-system`, or TEMPORARY_EXTERNAL_PARTICIPANT with `meeting-participant:<lowercase hyphenated uuid>`.

externalId.description: 1-128 printable ASCII characters without spaces; telephone numbers, tel: / sip: URIs and the reserved tombstoned: prefix are refused.

displayName.description: 1-64 characters, no control characters; null clears it.

imageUrl.description: An https:// URL of at most 512 characters; null clears it.

ConsoleTestUserTokenRequest.description: A console test token request: as UpsertEndUserAndMintRequest, with ttlSeconds at most 3600.

OAuthClientRequest.description: ADR 0064: the OAuth client profile of an EXTERNAL tenant's application (full replacement). Redirect URIs: exact https:// URIs, http://localhost[:port] only while DRAFT, no fragment, no wildcard, at most 10. userScopes: user / install scopes; botScopes: bot / install scopes. testAccountIds: the CF Meet accounts that may authorize while DRAFT. allowedAccountIds / allowedOrganizationIds: PRIVATE distribution allow lists synced by the Developer Console (its workspace members' accounts, and organizations owned by one of them) — Platform Access does not know workspace membership. Optional presentation: developerName (else the developer tenant's name), logoUrl (https, ≤ 512) and meetingSurface; omitted values are cleared (full replacement).

items.description: OAuth scope of the closed catalogue (version 1, Platform Access identity/oauth_scopes.rs).
OAuth scope of the closed catalogue (version 1, Platform Access identity/oauth_scopes.rs).

testAccountIds.description: At most 25 CF Meet account ids (DRAFT authorization).

developerName.description: Optional override of the developer tenant's display name.

OAuthClient.description: ADR 0064: an OAuth client profile (clientId = application id). revokedGrants is present on PUT (grants revoked by a SUSPENDED status). secretIssuedAt: issue time of the current client secret (absent before the first).

items.description: OAuth scope of the closed catalogue (version 1, Platform Access identity/oauth_scopes.rs).
OAuth scope of the closed catalogue (version 1, Platform Access identity/oauth_scopes.rs).

OAuthClientSecret.description: ADR 0064: a new client secret, shown ONCE (`cfcs_<sbx|test|live>_<24hex>_<64hex>`, verifier-only storage). The previous secret keeps working for 24 h.

OAuthGrant.description: ADR 0064: an app grant (installation). USER: accountId; ORGANIZATION: organizationId. tenantId / applicationId / environmentId: the target FIRST_PARTY triple; principalId: the restricted user (NATIVE_CF_USER cfmeet-user:<accountId>) or bot (BOT_OR_SERVICE app:<appId>) principal; serviceAccountId: the installation service account. app: what the Meeting Service shows (name, developerName, logoUrl, meetingSurface); sub: the pairwise subject (same as introspection).

items.description: OAuth scope of the closed catalogue (version 1, Platform Access identity/oauth_scopes.rs).

sub.description: The pairwise subject of the grant for its app (same HMAC as introspection).

OAuthAuthorizationRequest.description: ADR 0064: an authorization request relayed by the Meeting Service for the account it authenticated. ORGANIZATION installs need organizationId (the organization's provisioned FIRST_PARTY scope, capability `primary`).

OAuthAuthorizationApproval.description: ADR 0064: an approved authorization (decision APPROVE; a denial never reaches Platform Access).

OAuthAuthorizationContext.description: ADR 0064: the consent data of a valid authorization request. An install scope (events:meetings) is shown with who = the grant's own principal (user / bot).

name.description: OAuth scope of the closed catalogue (version 1, Platform Access identity/oauth_scopes.rs).

OAuthAuthorizationResult.description: ADR 0064: the single-use authorization code (60 s, verifier-only, bound to client, redirect URI, PKCE challenge and grant) and the grant id.

OAuthTokenRequest.description: ADR 0064: the token endpoint backend (camelCase; the Developer Console speaks RFC 6749 outside). grantType authorization_code needs code, redirectUri and codeVerifier; refresh_token needs refreshToken.

OAuthTokenResult.description: ADR 0064: issued tokens. accessToken cfoa_ (1 h), refreshToken cfor_ (90 d, rotating, single use), botToken cfob_ only on the first authorization-code exchange of an ORGANIZATION grant with bot scopes. scope: the grant's (accumulated) OAuth scopes.

OAuthRevokeRequest.description: ADR 0064: RFC 7009 revocation of an access, bot or refresh token owned by the authenticated client.

OAuthIntrospection.description: ADR 0064: active only for a live cfoa_ / cfob_ token of an ACTIVE grant with a FULL authority chain (refresh tokens are never active here). sub is pairwise: base64url(HMAC-SHA-256(server key, appId, subject)), subject = the account id (USER) or `organization:<id>` (ORGANIZATION); stable per app, different across apps.

items.description: OAuth scope of the closed catalogue (version 1, Platform Access identity/oauth_scopes.rs).

OAuthMeetingSurface.description: The app's in-meeting surface: an https page and the exact https origins (scheme://host[:port], at most 10) it is served from.

tags.description: The admin bridge's read-only operator views of the identity hierarchy (ADR 0068). platform-identity.administer plus the bridge's HQ operator; never a secret, verifier or external reference.

get.description: Liveness.
Readiness: database reachable and no migration pending (counts and versions only).

post.description: Validate a presented customer credential and return its trusted authority chain (or the rejection reason and any throttle). The presented value is never logged or stored. Permission: `platform-credential.authenticate`.

get.description: Status, expiry and revocation of a credential of the delegated scope (no secret, no verifier). Permission: `platform-identity.read`. Requires the delegated platform context signed into the caller's service token (cfmeet.platform.delegated-platform-context); its tenant / application are re-validated here and never trusted on their own.

post.description: Re-evaluate NOW whether the credential of the delegated scope may perform an operation needing the given scopes (optionally for a principal). Permission: `platform-identity.read`. Requires the delegated platform context signed into the caller's service token (cfmeet.platform.delegated-platform-context); its tenant / application are re-validated here and never trusted on their own.

get.description: The trusted context of the caller's delegated scope: tenant, application, environment, service account and authority mode. Permission: `platform-identity.read`. Requires the delegated platform context signed into the caller's service token (cfmeet.platform.delegated-platform-context); its tenant / application are re-validated here and never trusted on their own.

post.description: A page of the identity change feed after the cursor (consumer projections). POST because internal requests carry no query strings. Permission: `platform-identity.read`.

get.description: Receipt of an operator-imported identity bundle (hand-off verification by the previous authority). Permission: `platform-identity.read`.
The server-authoritative scope registry (Calling, Numbering and SMS scopes; trust levels). Permission: `platform-identity.read`.

post.description: Resolve principal references inside the delegated scope only. Permission: `platform-principal.resolve`. Requires the delegated platform context signed into the caller's service token (cfmeet.platform.delegated-platform-context); its tenant / application are re-validated here and never trusted on their own.

Get or create the TELEPHONE_ENDPOINT principal of a protected public party (by ContactReference, never a number). Idempotent. Permission: `platform-principal.register`. Requires the delegated platform context signed into the caller's service token (cfmeet.platform.delegated-platform-context); its tenant / application are re-validated here and never trusted on their own.

Part V H §104: get or create the NATIVE_CF_USER / TEMPORARY_EXTERNAL_PARTICIPANT principal of an account the first-party login authority (Meeting Service) authenticated itself. Idempotent. Permission: `platform-principal.ensure`. Requires the delegated platform context signed into the caller's service token; it must be a FIRST_PARTY tenant at FULL authority (EXTERNAL → POLICY_VIOLATION, suspended chain or principal → INVALID_STATE).

post.summary: Mirror a first-party account status onto its principal
post.description: Blueprint v1.0 Section 14 (ACC-010). The first-party account authority (the Meeting Service, permission platform-principal.ensure, signed delegated context of a FULL-authority FIRST_PARTY tenant) sets the NATIVE_CF_USER principal of externalReference to the account's CURRENT status: ACTIVE, SUSPENDED or DEACTIVATED. Idempotent (changed=false when already so). Never creates a principal (unknown reference: NOT_FOUND) and never changes a tombstoned one (INVALID_STATE).
Tombstone a principal for good (audited with the named human operator). Idempotent. Permission: `platform-principal.register`.

Part VI §51: the CURRENT authority chain of the API credential the API Gateway authenticated, for a receiving domain service. The credential id is taken only from the signed delegated context (`initiating_credential_id`) and must belong exactly to the delegated tenant / application / environment / service account; revocation, expiry, supersession, suspension and effective scopes are evaluated now. No secret is presented. Permission: `platform-credential.authenticate`.
post.summary: Resolve the current authority chain of a gateway-authenticated credential

put.summary: Create, return or renew an organization's service binding
put.description: Idempotent on the path (ADR 0058 Amendment A2). The first call, in ONE transaction, grants the service's closed scope set to the organization's first-party application, creates the service account in the organization's PRODUCTION environment, issues a credential with exactly those scopes and records the binding; it answers 201. Later calls answer 200 with the same ids, except that a credential that no longer authenticates (expired, revoked, superseded), expires within 30 days or carries other scopes is replaced for the same service account (predecessor revoked, revision + 1). Concurrent calls serialize. 404 when the organization scope was never provisioned; 409 when the tenant / application / environment is not ACTIVE, the binding was revoked, its credential is suspended, or a service account with the reserved name exists outside the binding registry (never adopted). Every committed change writes the operator audit (SCOPE_GRANTED, SERVICE_ACCOUNT_CREATED, CREDENTIAL_CREATED / CREDENTIAL_ROTATED / CREDENTIAL_REVOKED) with detail.organizationRef and detail.service. Permission `platform-identity.bind-organization-services` (grantable to cfmeet.organizations only) and the authenticated cfmeet.organizations identity; any other caller is INTERNAL_PERMISSION_DENIED. The credential secret is never returned (it is discarded at issuance; only its verifier is stored).

post.summary: Create or return a partner user
post.description: Creates the partner user `externalId` of the forwarded credential's environment (201), or returns the existing one (200; idempotent on externalId; given profile fields are applied). Credential scope `principals.write`. New users count against the environment cap of ACTIVE users (PLATFORM_ACCESS_MAX_END_USERS_SANDBOX / _TEST / _PRODUCTION; 409 LIMIT_EXCEEDED). Audited (PRINCIPAL_REGISTERED / PRINCIPAL_PROFILE_SET). Developer Console only: permission `platform-end-users.delegate`; the `CF-Forwarded-Credential-Id` credential is re-verified live and is the only source of the environment (no longer authenticating or not matching the signed delegated context: DELEGATED_CONTEXT_INVALID; header missing: DELEGATED_CONTEXT_REQUIRED); its tenant must be EXTERNAL (POLICY_VIOLATION) and its chain ACTIVE (INVALID_STATE). A user of another environment is NOT_FOUND. Behind PLATFORM_ACCESS_END_USERS_ENABLED (off: 404 NOT_FOUND).

post.summary: Upsert a partner user and mint a user token

Credential scopes `principals.write` and `user_tokens.issue` (+ grant scopes). Minting also needs PLATFORM_ACCESS_USER_TOKENS_ENABLED, the scope `user_tokens.issue` plus each grant's scope (SCOPE_REQUIRED), an ACTIVE user (INVALID_STATE) and at most 120 mints per user per clock hour (429 RATE_LIMITED). The response is `Cache-Control: no-store`. Developer Console only: permission `platform-end-users.delegate`; the `CF-Forwarded-Credential-Id` credential is re-verified live and is the only source of the environment (no longer authenticating or not matching the signed delegated context: DELEGATED_CONTEXT_INVALID; header missing: DELEGATED_CONTEXT_REQUIRED); its tenant must be EXTERNAL (POLICY_VIOLATION) and its chain ACTIVE (INVALID_STATE). A user of another environment is NOT_FOUND. Behind PLATFORM_ACCESS_END_USERS_ENABLED (off: 404 NOT_FOUND).

get.description: Credential scope `principals.read`. Developer Console only: permission `platform-end-users.delegate`; the `CF-Forwarded-Credential-Id` credential is re-verified live and is the only source of the environment (no longer authenticating or not matching the signed delegated context: DELEGATED_CONTEXT_INVALID; header missing: DELEGATED_CONTEXT_REQUIRED); its tenant must be EXTERNAL (POLICY_VIOLATION) and its chain ACTIVE (INVALID_STATE). patch.description: Changes the given profile fields and / or the status (ACTIVE / SUSPENDED; a suspended user's tokens stop verifying; reactivation counts against the cap: LIMIT_EXCEEDED). Credential scope `principals.write`. Audited (PRINCIPAL_STATUS_SET / PRINCIPAL_PROFILE_SET). Developer Console only: permission `platform-end-users.delegate`; the `CF-Forwarded-Credential-Id` credential is re-verified live and is the only source of the environment (no longer authenticating or not matching the signed delegated context: DELEGATED_CONTEXT_INVALID; header missing: DELEGATED_CONTEXT_REQUIRED); its tenant must be EXTERNAL (POLICY_VIOLATION) and its chain ACTIVE (INVALID_STATE). A user of another environment is NOT_FOUND. Behind PLATFORM_ACCESS_END_USERS_ENABLED (off: 404 NOT_FOUND).

delete.description: Tombstones the user: DEACTIVATED for ever, externalId replaced, profile erased, ids kept; every token of the user stops verifying. A deleted user is NOT_FOUND afterwards. Credential scope `principals.write`. Audited (PRINCIPAL_TOMBSTONED). Developer Console only: permission `platform-end-users.delegate`; the `CF-Forwarded-Credential-Id` credential is re-verified live and is the only source of the environment (no longer authenticating or not matching the signed delegated context: DELEGATED_CONTEXT_INVALID; header missing: DELEGATED_CONTEXT_REQUIRED); its tenant must be EXTERNAL (POLICY_VIOLATION) and its chain ACTIVE (INVALID_STATE). A user of another environment is NOT_FOUND. Behind PLATFORM_ACCESS_END_USERS_ENABLED (off: 404 NOT_FOUND).

post.description: Advances the user's session epoch: every user token issued before `tokensNotBefore` is USER_TOKEN_REVOKED (and the device credentials derived from it end). Credential scope `principals.write`. Audited (PRINCIPAL_SESSIONS_REVOKED). Developer Console only: permission `platform-end-users.delegate`; the `CF-Forwarded-Credential-Id` credential is re-verified live and is the only source of the environment (no longer authenticating or not matching the signed delegated context: DELEGATED_CONTEXT_INVALID; header missing: DELEGATED_CONTEXT_REQUIRED); its tenant must be EXTERNAL (POLICY_VIOLATION) and its chain ACTIVE (INVALID_STATE). A user of another environment is NOT_FOUND. Behind PLATFORM_ACCESS_END_USERS_ENABLED (off: 404 NOT_FOUND).

Mints a CF Meet user token (`cfut_<sbx|test|live>_<JWS>`, Ed25519, default 3600 s, 60-86400 s) for an existing partner user. Credential scope `user_tokens.issue` (+ grant scopes). Minting also needs PLATFORM_ACCESS_USER_TOKENS_ENABLED, the scope `user_tokens.issue` plus each grant's scope (SCOPE_REQUIRED), an ACTIVE user (INVALID_STATE) and at most 120 mints per user per clock hour (429 RATE_LIMITED). The response is `Cache-Control: no-store`. Developer Console only: permission `platform-end-users.delegate`; the `CF-Forwarded-Credential-Id` credential is re-verified live and is the only source of the environment (no longer authenticating or not matching the signed delegated context: DELEGATED_CONTEXT_INVALID; header missing: DELEGATED_CONTEXT_REQUIRED); its tenant must be EXTERNAL (POLICY_VIOLATION) and its chain ACTIVE (INVALID_STATE). A user of another environment is NOT_FOUND. Behind PLATFORM_ACCESS_END_USERS_ENABLED (off: 404 NOT_FOUND).

get.description: ADR 0062 console read for human members: the visible partner users of an environment in creation order (an unknown environment is NOT_FOUND). Developer Platform delegation: permission `platform-identity.delegate` (Developer Platform only); read-only. Behind PLATFORM_ACCESS_END_USERS_ENABLED (off: 404 NOT_FOUND).

post.description: Verifies a CF Meet user token: exact header (`{"alg":"EdDSA","typ":"cfmeet-user+jwt","kid":"<16 hex>"}`), Ed25519 signature by a known key, at most 2048 bytes, issuer `cfmeet.platform-access`, audience `cfmeet.platform.client`, environment tag, nbf / exp with 60 s skew; then live: the user is ACTIVE and not deleted, iat >= its session epoch, the minting credential and service account still authenticate, the tenant (EXTERNAL), application and environment are ACTIVE, every id matches, the signing key is not retired. 401 USER_TOKEN_INVALID / USER_TOKEN_EXPIRED / USER_TOKEN_REVOKED. Returns the EFFECTIVE grants. Permission `platform-user-token.verify`. Behind PLATFORM_ACCESS_USER_TOKENS_ENABLED (off: 404 NOT_FOUND).

get.description: The Ed25519 public keys of user tokens (the signing key and previous keys ACTIVE, retired keys RETIRED) for stateless pre-checks; the owning service always verifies live. Permission `platform-user-token.verify`. Behind PLATFORM_ACCESS_USER_TOKENS_ENABLED (off: 404 NOT_FOUND).

Changes after `after` (one item per change of an environment's origins or effective status, carrying the latest state). Permission `platform-environment-origins.read`. Behind PLATFORM_ACCESS_ENVIRONMENT_ORIGINS_ENABLED (off: 404 NOT_FOUND).

The exact origins of an environment (empty when none; an unknown environment is NOT_FOUND). Permission `platform-environment-origins.read`. Behind PLATFORM_ACCESS_ENVIRONMENT_ORIGINS_ENABLED (off: 404 NOT_FOUND).

ADR 0062: the exact origins of an environment. Developer Platform delegation: permission `platform-identity.delegate` (Developer Platform only); read-only. Behind PLATFORM_ACCESS_ENVIRONMENT_ORIGINS_ENABLED (off: 404 NOT_FOUND).

put.description: ADR 0062: replaces the exact origins of an EXTERNAL tenant's environment (FIRST_PARTY: POLICY_VIOLATION; invalid origin or more than 20: VALIDATION_ERROR). A change writes one feed item and one audit row (ENVIRONMENT_ORIGINS_SET); an unchanged list writes nothing. Developer Platform delegation: permission `platform-identity.delegate` (Developer Platform only); mutations name the acting party (`X-CF-Delegated-Actor`). Behind PLATFORM_ACCESS_ENVIRONMENT_ORIGINS_ENABLED (off: 404 NOT_FOUND).

post.description: ADR 0062: idempotently ensures the fixed meeting system principal (BOT_OR_SERVICE `cfmeet:meeting-system`) or a temporary meeting participant (TEMPORARY_EXTERNAL_PARTICIPANT `meeting-participant:<uuid>`) of an ACTIVE environment (application and tenant ACTIVE) of an EXTERNAL tenant. Any other combination: VALIDATION_ERROR; FIRST_PARTY: POLICY_VIOLATION; suspended chain or principal: INVALID_STATE; unknown environment: NOT_FOUND. Permission `platform-principal.ensure-meeting-platform` (Meeting Service only). Behind PLATFORM_ACCESS_MEETING_PLATFORM_ENABLED (off: 404 NOT_FOUND).

post.summary: Upsert a partner user and mint a test user token (console)
post.description: ADR 0062: a Developer Console member mints a short-lived CF Meet user token for testing, without an API credential. Only for an ACTIVE SANDBOX environment of an EXTERNAL tenant (FIRST_PARTY tenant, TEST / PRODUCTION environment, or a suspended environment / application / tenant: POLICY_VIOLATION; unknown environment: NOT_FOUND). Creates or returns (applying given profile fields) the partner user `externalId` (the SANDBOX cap applies: 409 LIMIT_EXCEEDED), then mints a token: ttlSeconds 60-3600 (default 3600); each grant needs the application's CURRENT scope grant applying to SANDBOX (messages.read / messages.send / calls.write / meetings.write; SCOPE_REQUIRED); ACTIVE user (INVALID_STATE); at most 120 mints per user per clock hour (429 RATE_LIMITED). The token carries no real credential: its `crd` / `sva` (verify: credentialId / serviceAccountId) are the environment's synthetic console-test markers (UUIDv8 derived from the environment id; never a real credential). Verification accepts it while the environment is SANDBOX, its chain ACTIVE (else USER_TOKEN_REVOKED) and the user ACTIVE and not session-revoked; effective grants = claimed grants ∩ the application's current SANDBOX scope grants. Audited (PRINCIPAL_REGISTERED / PRINCIPAL_PROFILE_SET, and USER_TOKEN_TEST_ISSUED per token). The response is `Cache-Control: no-store`. Developer Platform delegation: permission `platform-identity.delegate` (Developer Platform only); mutations name the acting party (`X-CF-Delegated-Actor`; missing: OPERATOR_REQUIRED). Behind PLATFORM_ACCESS_END_USERS_ENABLED and PLATFORM_ACCESS_USER_TOKENS_ENABLED (off: 404 NOT_FOUND).

put.summary: Create or replace an app's OAuth client profile
put.description: Permission `platform-oauth.manage` (Developer Console). The application must belong to an EXTERNAL tenant (FIRST_PARTY: POLICY_VIOLATION; unknown: NOT_FOUND). 201 when created, 200 when replaced. status SUSPENDED revokes every grant of the app (all tokens, bots deactivated, APP_GRANT changes) in the same transaction. Behind PLATFORM_ACCESS_OAUTH_ENABLED (off: 404 NOT_FOUND).

parameters.name: applicationId
parameters.description: The app's application id (= client id).

get.summary: Read an app's OAuth client profile
get.description: Permission `platform-oauth.manage`. Unknown client: NOT_FOUND. Behind PLATFORM_ACCESS_OAUTH_ENABLED (off: 404 NOT_FOUND).

parameters.name: applicationId
parameters.description: The app's application id (= client id).

post.description: Permission `platform-oauth.manage`. Returns the new secret ONCE (Cache-Control: no-store); the previous secret keeps authenticating for 24 h. Unknown client: NOT_FOUND. Behind PLATFORM_ACCESS_OAUTH_ENABLED (off: 404 NOT_FOUND).

get.description: Permission `platform-oauth.manage`. Every grant of the app (ACTIVE and REVOKED) in creation order; cursor = the last grant id of the previous page. Behind PLATFORM_ACCESS_OAUTH_ENABLED (off: 404 NOT_FOUND).

post.description: Permission `platform-oauth.authorize` (Meeting Service). No side effect. 400 INVALID_CLIENT (unknown client), INVALID_REDIRECT_URI (not registered exactly, or localhost outside DRAFT), INVALID_SCOPE (empty, outside the catalogue, not requested by the client or not for the target), PKCE_REQUIRED (codeChallengeMethod must be S256 with a 43-character challenge), APP_NOT_AVAILABLE (distribution / status rules: SUSPENDED nobody, DRAFT test accounts only, PRIVATE allow lists, PUBLIC+PUBLISHED anyone); organization without a provisioned / active FIRST_PARTY scope: 409 INVALID_STATE. Behind PLATFORM_ACCESS_OAUTH_ENABLED (off: 404 NOT_FOUND).

Permission `platform-oauth.authorize` (Meeting Service). Validates like /validate, then ensures the principal (USER: NATIVE_CF_USER cfmeet-user:<accountId> in CF Meet's FIRST_PARTY personal communications environment — the one named by the caller's signed delegated context, re-validated (FIRST_PARTY, FULL authority), or PLATFORM_ACCESS_OAUTH_PERSONAL_ENVIRONMENT_ID without a context; ORGANIZATION: BOT_OR_SERVICE app:<appId> in the organization's FIRST_PARTY triple) and the installation service account `app-<appId hex>` of the (app, environment), creates the grant or accumulates its scopes, and returns a single-use code (60 s). Behind PLATFORM_ACCESS_OAUTH_ENABLED (off: 404 NOT_FOUND).

get.summary: List an account's or organization's grants
get.description: Permission `platform-oauth.authorize`. Exactly one of accountId (ACTIVE USER grants) or organizationId (ACTIVE ORGANIZATION grants). Behind PLATFORM_ACCESS_OAUTH_ENABLED (off: 404 NOT_FOUND).

delete.description: Permission `platform-oauth.authorize`. Idempotent: revokes every access / bot token and refresh token and pending code, deactivates the bot of an ORGANIZATION grant and records an APP_GRANT change with status REVOKED. Optional accountId / organizationId scope the call to that owner (another owner's grant: NOT_FOUND). Behind PLATFORM_ACCESS_OAUTH_ENABLED (off: 404 NOT_FOUND).

post.description: Permission `platform-oauth.token` (Developer Console). Client authentication with the client secret. Errors carry RFC 6749 codes in error.code: invalid_request (400), invalid_client (401), invalid_grant (400: unknown / expired / foreign code or refresh token, wrong redirect URI, PKCE verifier mismatch, revoked grant), unsupported_grant_type (400). Presenting a consumed code or a superseded refresh token revokes the grant. Cache-Control: no-store. Behind PLATFORM_ACCESS_OAUTH_ENABLED (off: 404 NOT_FOUND).

Permission `platform-oauth.token`. Always 200 `{}`: a token is revoked only when the client authenticates and owns it (access / bot: the credential; refresh: that refresh token). Behind PLATFORM_ACCESS_OAUTH_ENABLED (off: 404 NOT_FOUND).
Permission `platform-oauth.token`. Returns `{active:false}` for anything that does not authenticate now. Behind PLATFORM_ACCESS_OAUTH_ENABLED (off: 404 NOT_FOUND).

get.description: Tenants in id order; q matches the slug or display name. Requires platform-identity.administer and the admin bridge's HQ operator (X-CF-Operator: hq:<staff>); refused (OPERATOR_REQUIRED) without it. Read-only, keyset paginated.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring of the slug or name.

get.description: The tenant's applications in id order. Requires platform-identity.administer and the admin bridge's HQ operator (X-CF-Operator: hq:<staff>); refused (OPERATOR_REQUIRED) without it. Read-only, keyset paginated.

The tenant's environments in id order. Requires platform-identity.administer and the admin bridge's HQ operator (X-CF-Operator: hq:<staff>); refused (OPERATOR_REQUIRED) without it. Read-only, keyset paginated.

get.summary: List a tenant's service accounts (admin bridge)
get.description: The tenant's service accounts in id order; the free-text description is not returned. Requires platform-identity.administer and the admin bridge's HQ operator (X-CF-Operator: hq:<staff>); refused (OPERATOR_REQUIRED) without it. Read-only, keyset paginated.

get.summary: List a tenant's scope grants (admin bridge)
get.description: Application scope grants ordered by application and scope; the cursor is `<applicationId>:<scope>`. Requires platform-identity.administer and the admin bridge's HQ operator (X-CF-Operator: hq:<staff>); refused (OPERATOR_REQUIRED) without it. Read-only, keyset paginated.

get.summary: List a tenant's API keys (admin bridge)
get.description: API keys in id order: public id, last four, scopes, state and times. Never the secret, the verifier, its algorithm or key version, or the free-text label. Requires platform-identity.administer and the admin bridge's HQ operator (X-CF-Operator: hq:<staff>); refused (OPERATOR_REQUIRED) without it. Read-only, keyset paginated.

The tenant's principals (partner users: kind EXTERNAL_APPLICATION_PRINCIPAL) in id order. q matches the principal id or the external reference EXACTLY; the external reference is never returned. Requires platform-identity.administer and the admin bridge's HQ operator (X-CF-Operator: hq:<staff>); refused (OPERATOR_REQUIRED) without it. Read-only, keyset paginated.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: A principal id or an exact external reference (matched, never returned).

get.summary: List a tenant's allowed websites (admin bridge)
get.description: Allowed websites per environment in environment id order (empty when none were set). Requires platform-identity.administer and the admin bridge's HQ operator (X-CF-Operator: hq:<staff>); refused (OPERATOR_REQUIRED) without it. Read-only, keyset paginated.

Principals across tenants matching q (required): a principal id or an exact external reference (which may be an email address). The external reference is never returned. Requires platform-identity.administer and the admin bridge's HQ operator (X-CF-Operator: hq:<staff>); refused (OPERATOR_REQUIRED) without it. Read-only, keyset paginated.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: A principal id or an exact external reference.

get.description: CF Meet Apps OAuth clients in application id order: name, scopes, distribution and status, and the number of redirect URIs (never the URIs or test accounts). q matches the name. Requires platform-identity.administer and the admin bridge's HQ operator (X-CF-Operator: hq:<staff>); refused (OPERATOR_REQUIRED) without it. Read-only, keyset paginated.

get.summary: List an OAuth app's grants (admin bridge)
get.description: Every grant (installation) of the app, any status, in id order. Requires platform-identity.administer and the admin bridge's HQ operator (X-CF-Operator: hq:<staff>); refused (OPERATOR_REQUIRED) without it. Read-only, keyset paginated.

get.summary: List the operator audit trail (admin bridge)
get.description: The operator audit trail, newest first, without the row detail; since/until bound the window (at most 31 days); the cursor is `<occurredAt micros>_<id>`. Requires platform-identity.administer and the admin bridge's HQ operator (X-CF-Operator: hq:<staff>); refused (OPERATOR_REQUIRED) without it. Read-only, keyset paginated.
